name: detect-monitor
summary: The Chapter 14 detection engine: diff a timeline of monitoring snapshots into a change feed, classify each change, score it against the Chapter 13 watchlist, correlate away cross-surface duplicates, suppress noise, and rank the alerts an analyst reads — graded by the detect scorer. The synthesis chapter of Part IV.

modules.changefeed.py: Parses snapshots and diffs consecutive pairs into a raw change feed; uses Ch10 content identity to tell a real change from a re-render (banner flip with stable content_id = churn).
modules.watchlist.py: Builds the watchlist from Ch13's HIGH-confidence operators (members + signed keys + wallets); reuses Ch13 fuse outright.
modules.classify.py: Types each raw change into a dark-web taxonomy: new_victim / publication / withdrawal / deadline_slip / market_down / new_mirror / new_clone / operator_resurface / cosmetic_churn.
modules.score.py: Assigns severity (critical..suppress) + confidence; a change to a watched operator's own infrastructure is boosted.
modules.correlate.py: Collapses cross-surface duplicates (a victim on a leak site and its byte-identical mirror) into one canonical alert; echoes Ch12 correlate + Ch10 content identity.
modules.pipeline.py: Runs the watch loop (feed->classify->score->correlate->suppress->rank); --selftest grades naive-vs-full with the detect scorer.

corpus: corpus/ — the detect lab: 3 monitoring snapshots (t1->t2->t3) of leak victims, markets, mirrors, clones, personas, and a flood of cosmetic churn pages. Engineered so every event type and both CRITICAL events (new_clone impersonation, operator_resurface) have ground truth, buried under churn + mirror duplicates. Watermarked synthetic.
reuses: ../persona-extract/fuse.py + identifiers.py (Ch13 -> the watchlist), Ch12 lifecycle-diff pattern, Ch10 content identity + union-find lineage. Watchlist key F19B7A0C4E82D5613FA0 is the Ch12/13 operator tell, so the resurfacing persona links to the Ch13 Alpha cluster.
consumed_by: ../detect-scorer/scorer.py (alert recall/precision, false_alerts, criticals surfaced, churn suppressed, duplicates collapsed)
guardrail: Detection WATCHES, it does not act. The engine emits alerts for defenders / incident response / victims and has no takedown, contact, or hack-back capability by construction (like Ch9 scope guard, Ch11 detect-only). Monitors the synthetic range only; preserves Ch13's pseudonym->pseudonym boundary.
